mapper.select:
WITH buckets AS ( SELECT gs::date AS period_start, LEAST(
gs::date + 7
(gs::date + interval '1 month')::date
, cast(#{to} as date) + 1 ) AS period_end_exclusive FROM generate_series( cast(#{from} as date)::timestamp, cast(#{to} as date)::timestamp,
interval '7 days' interval '1 month'
) gs ), eligible AS ( SELECT s.started_at, s.ended_at, r.avg_viewers, r.total_chat FROM broadcast_sessions s JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = s.id WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND s.status = 'ENDED' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') AND s.ended_at > ( cast(#{from} as date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ) AND s.started_at < ( (cast(#{to} as date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ) ), bucket_session_overlaps AS ( SELECT b.period_start, b.period_end_exclusive, e.started_at, e.avg_viewers, e.total_chat, CASE WHEN e.started_at IS NULL OR e.ended_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST( extract(epoch FROM LEAST( e.ended_at, b.period_end_exclusive::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ) - GREATEST( e.started_at, b.period_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ) ), 0 ) END AS overlap_seconds FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN eligible e ON e.started_at < ( b.period_end_exclusive::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ) AND e.ended_at > ( b.period_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ) ) SELECT period_start, (period_end_exclusive::date - 1) AS period_end, round( sum(avg_viewers * overlap_seconds) FILTER (WHERE avg_viewers IS NOT NULL) / nullif( sum(overlap_seconds) FILTER (WHERE avg_viewers IS NOT NULL), 0 ) )::int AS average_viewers, coalesce(sum(total_chat) FILTER ( WHERE started_at >= ( period_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ) AND started_at < ( period_end_exclusive::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ) ), 0)::bigint AS total_chat, round(coalesce(sum(overlap_seconds), 0) / 60.0)::bigint AS broadcast_minutes FROM bucket_session_overlaps GROUP BY period_start, period_end_exclusive ORDER BY period_start

mapper.select: SELECT FROM growth_action_generations WHERE id = #{generationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT ON (growth_goal_id)
FROM growth_action_generations WHERE growth_goal_id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY growth_goal_id, requested_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM growth_action_generations WHERE growth_goal_id = #{goalId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY requested_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM growth_goals g JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.streamer_id = g.streamer_id AND (s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date BETWEEN g.period_start AND g.period_end JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = s.id WHERE g.id = #{goalId} AND s.status = 'ENDED' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') )

SELECT r.id AS report_id, s.title, s.ended_at, r.status, r.avg_viewers, r.peak_viewers, coalesce(r.total_chat, 0)::bigint AS total_chat, round(extract(epoch FROM (s.ended_at - s.started_at)) / 60.0)::bigint AS broadcast_minutes, coalesce(r.summary, '') AS summary FROM growth_goals g JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.streamer_id = g.streamer_id AND (s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date BETWEEN g.period_start AND g.period_end JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = s.id WHERE g.id = #{goalId} AND s.status = 'ENDED' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY s.ended_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.id, g.streamer_id, g.metric_type, g.target_value, g.unit, g.period_start, g.period_end, g.status, g.revision FROM reports r JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id JOIN growth_goals g ON g.streamer_id = s.streamer_id AND (s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date BETWEEN g.period_start AND g.period_end WHERE r.id = #{reportId} AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.id

UPDATE growth_action_generations SET status = 'COMPLETED', input_fingerprint = #{fingerprint}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{generationId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
